basis: Pointer sampling is synchronous; no in-page requestAnimationFrame promise remains. Node's 3-second sampling deadline can be exceeded by its in-flight CDP call, but tests/browser/vault-owned-cdp.cjs rejects every command after 5 seconds. Initial sample plus deadline and final in-flight command therefore remain finitely bounded (about 13 seconds), including transport.
input: Unique visible target and center hit-target are checked; a real CDP mouse press/release clicks the port input, focus is asserted, then Input.insertText is checked against DOM value and focus before Set. No DOM focus/value assignment or port-storage seeding.
reset: Cancel asserts theme, port, and exact guest session fixture persist. Confirm asserts prior local/session keys are cleared; reload asserts guest controls and System default with theme, port, and fixture absent.
scope: Independent source and transport review only; no browser, tests, build, install, or runtime acceptance executed.
